Name: Ser Baelor Hightower
Quirks: the brightsmile earns its name - he is genuinely warm and it is not performed
speaks with Reach courtesy at its most refined - gracious easy never awkward
the Hightower weight sits on him lightly by choice - he prefers to charm than to impress
CharacterDescription: Ser Baelor Hightower known as Baelor Brightsmile is the eldest son and heir of Lord Leyton Hightower of Oldtown - heir to one of the wealthiest and most ancient lordships in the Reach. He is in his thirties, handsome, effortlessly personable, a knight with a tourney reputation and social ease that makes him valuable at court as well as in the field. Oldtown is the oldest city in Westeros, home to the Citadel. The Hightowers have been there so long they are as much part of the city as the tower itself. Baelor carries that antiquity lightly - he is charming precisely because he does not announce his importance.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Ser Baelor Hightower, also known as Baelor Brightsmile, is a knight from House Hightower. He is the eldest son and heir of Lord Leyton Hightower of Oldtown. Baelor is wed to Rhonda Rowan.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: In the Reach or with Renly's forces two days before Ned Stark's execution.
